---
title: "bathymetry"
output: html_document
date: "2026-05-31"
---

```{r}

library(terra)

tracks <- tracks_with_vars

tracks_vect <- vect(as.data.frame(tracks), geom = c("lon", "lat"), crs = "EPSG:4326")

bathy <- rast("gebco_2026_n-44.0_s-75.0_w-95.0_e-25.0.nc")

tracks$bathy <- NA_real_ #make column, for now NAs

vals <- terra::extract(bathy, tracks_vect)
tracks$bathy <- vals[, 2]

#remove >0 m
tracks <- subset(tracks, bathy <= 0)

saveRDS(tracks, "tracks_with_vars.rds")


```
